assets.subject: Owner-accepted S1-01 look: compact premium sculpted 3D CARTOON educational miniature on warm off-white, plausible rural field-store, matte route surface, wood, metal, blank card and earth materials, clean silhouette, soft studio contact shadows, blank margins for later four-language overlays. LOW ROUTE-LEVEL THREE-QUARTER view, not an overhead map. A modest field-store model is at left and a fenced hazard zone far BEHIND it. A wide clean path from the store reaches a neutral junction OUTSIDE the hazard boundary; beyond the junction are TWO separate blank destination props at safe distance: an open assembly-board plinth and a closed shelter structure. They are alternative destinations subject to the actual hazard/site plan, never both automatically appropriate. At the junction a blank removable attendance-token rack has one empty slot among several plain tokens, and an empty coordinator call-point prop nearby. There is no person and no suggestion to re-enter the fenced zone to find the missing token. Preserve an obvious safe route that never crosses the hazard fence. No simulated chemical cloud, wildfire, lightning, live incident, or universal outdoor-muster claim. No printed words, numbers, arrows, pseudo-writing, school, Spark, brand, logo or watermark. The selected route/destination and missing-person action will be explained only in separately editable four-language text and audio. Compositionally different from a future elevated whole-site still.

TARGETED REPAIR OF ONLY THIS FOUR-POD CASE BOARD. Keep the owner-accepted Masaarat S1-01 compact sculpted 3D CARTOON style on warm off-white, realistic dry plastic, cloth, grass, soil and metal textures, soft shadows and four fully separated pod islands with generous gutters for individual cropping. No fixed text or labels. POD ONE: closed blank harmless training bottle, unused clean eyewash and blank SDS holder, no exposed person or actual chemical. POD TWO: empty shade canopy, water vessel and cooling cloth, no patient and no implication of giving drinks to a confused person. POD THREE MUST BE A TINY SHALLOW GRASS-EDGE UNEVEN PATCH, no deeper than a shoe sole and SMALLER THAN ONE SAFETY CONE BASE, partly hidden by grass, marked off with small cones and a low strip barrier; NO open pit, crater, excavation, black void or exposed deep soil wall. Empty first-aid kit and blank call-card holder may sit outside the boundary; no casualty. POD FOUR: solid screen around unknown-air zone at the back; a broad pale path STARTS near the front and visibly CURVES AWAY toward the outer left edge, NEVER leading into, aiming at or ending at the screen. No plume or approach. No people, hands, body parts, medical treatment, active spill, actual toxin, hazardous rescue, emergency call, words, numbers, arrows, pseudo-writing, school/Spark, branding, logos or watermark. All four case facts/actions will be separately editable four-locale overlays and spoken script. The earlier candidate with a GIANT excavation and a path pointed toward the screen was REJECTED; correct those two defects while preserving the separate board concept.
